records.answer: The proposal map places one legal issuer among supervisors, its parent, reserve claims, custodians, service providers, holders and payout banks. These are different legal relationships, not a chart of an approved company or a transfer of the issuer’s duties.

records.answer: The four kinds of books and seven accounting layers describe different jobs. A proprietary balance-sheet entry, a fiduciary register and an operational message are not interchangeable evidence.
